name: Minamichita (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamichita town emblem in blue: two facing curved strokes crossed by a horizontal bar, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Minamichita, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 July 1963.

features.role: Minamichita town emblem — two facing curved strokes crossed by a horizontal bar, like a stylised character
